boundary: Configuration index; the linked guide sections remain the maintained technical explanations. No new AWS resource types or cross-product runtime are implied.

entries.title: Provider registration and selected tools
entries.configuration: Configure endpoint, authentication, selected resources and private routing when needed. Test the actual read identity.

entries.title: Resource discovery and topology
entries.configuration: Connect relevant accounts, repositories and telemetry; compare inferred relationships with the deployed system.

entries.title: Memory stores and entries
entries.configuration: Inspect descriptions, active state and applicable custom-agent attachments. Keep original incident evidence in its source system.

entries.title: Global and agent-specific instructions
entries.configuration: Save standing guidance at the intended scope and test a new applicable session. Existing sessions retain startup content.

entries.title: Skills and supporting references
entries.configuration: Package a reviewed procedure, identify its matching conditions and actual tools, and test applicability. Skills do not grant access.

entries.title: Custom-agent definitions
entries.configuration: Define objective, source scope, output and failed-read behavior. Select real tools instead of assuming all provider tools are available.

entries.title: Custom-agent schedule triggers
entries.configuration: Separate schedule timing from observation window. Inspect actual starts and accepted timing constraints; do not promise real-time delivery.

entries.title: Invocation history and trajectories
entries.configuration: Inspect tool arguments, results and failures. Pausing future triggers and cancelling current work are separate controls.

entries.title: Incident triage and investigations
entries.configuration: Supply service identity, incident time and evidence. Distinguish routing correction, investigation steering and completed-investigation feedback.

entries.title: Incident-prevention evaluations
entries.configuration: Review source investigations and recommendation state; assign implementation ownership separately from proposal generation.

entries.title: Directed actions
entries.configuration: Verify opt-in, eligible target access, classification and approval for the exact operation. A recommendation is not authorization.

entries.title: Release-readiness review
entries.configuration: Check preview, repository and Region eligibility and retain the exact candidate revision.

entries.title: Release testing
entries.configuration: Use an authorized disposable application and test identities. Requests can change application data.

entries.title: Application sources and integrations
entries.configuration: Select the supported sources and revisions. Source reads, repair proposals and external publication are distinct operations.

entries.title: Target and network configuration
entries.configuration: Define permitted targets and supporting access under owner authorization. Network reachability does not widen assessment scope.

entries.title: Test credentials and preflight
entries.configuration: Configure the selected credential strategy and actual application role. Retrieval success is not authentication success.

entries.title: Login Optimization
entries.configuration: Inspect reuse after successful authentication. Disabling reuse is not the same as deleting learned information.

entries.title: Penetration-test configurations and runs
entries.configuration: Record target revision, identities, exclusions and work limits for each independent execution.

entries.title: Finding evidence and disposition
entries.configuration: Retain finding identity through review, repair and verification. Record incomplete assessment coverage.

entries.title: Code-remediation proposals
entries.configuration: Check provider-specific support. Review and test the proposal; deployment and revalidation remain separate.

entries.title: Finding revalidation jobs
entries.configuration: Deploy the repair to the intended authorized target and verify current authentication before interpreting non-reproduction.

entries.title: Security requirement packs
entries.configuration: Review and enable criteria. Regeneration replaces existing pack contents, including manual entries; it is not evaluation.

entries.title: Source-code reviews
entries.configuration: Select revision, vulnerability and requirement modes independently. Provider and preview eligibility apply.

entries.title: Design reviews
entries.configuration: Identify the design revision and applicable requirements; use the supported new-review path for changed material.

entries.title: Threat-model configurations
entries.configuration: Review inferred system boundaries and flows before accepting individual threats.

entries.title: Pipeline assessment integration
entries.configuration: Bind the supported invocation to an authorized assessment. Define a team decision for errors and incomplete results.

entries.title: Jira finding publication
entries.configuration: Review destination audience, supported operations and finding linkage. Removing a connection does not delete published records.

entries.title: Cost and operational source access
entries.configuration: Activate required upstream services and scope access. Keep historical amounts, forecasts, coverage and recommendation estimates distinct.

entries.title: Context files
entries.configuration: Maintain reviewed mappings and report conventions. Files are visible to agent users and are not conversationally rewritten.

entries.title: Conversational memory
entries.configuration: Request remember, update or forget and test a later session separately from file retrieval.

entries.title: Conversation context management
entries.configuration: Restate material query constraints during long conversations. Compaction is not verbatim retention of all prior messages.

entries.title: Task queue and history
entries.configuration: Create explicit tasks and inspect actual execution and outputs rather than only the creation acknowledgement.

entries.title: Scheduled and event automations
entries.configuration: Configure schedule or supported anomaly event. Future task creation and already-created task lifecycle remain separate.

entries.title: Jira issue and comment actions
entries.configuration: Interactive and on-demand operations request approval; scheduled or event-driven operations use setup-time authorization.

entries.title: Slack message publication
entries.configuration: Review audience and membership before invocation. Posting has no per-message approval prompt, including interactive invocation.

entries.title: Report artifacts
entries.configuration: Retain task identity and query basis; verify numerical content before distribution. External copies have their own lifecycle.
